response.public_semantics: rows provide raccoon rabies positive and negative surveillance counts by grid/site, season, year and surveillance method

response_unit.method_mix_features: for each publicly described surveillance method column/category, proportion of sampled raccoons contributed by that method; category vocabulary is discovered only after response access and is represented deterministically by sorted method strings without outcome-based selection

chronology.order: ascending numeric year then deterministic normalized season order
chronology.unknown_season_string_rule: lexicographic order after known normalized labels; no post-response edit
chronology.layer_b_sources_for_target: positive eligible units from strictly earlier chronological contexts only

geometry.source: response-blind CovariateData.csv with 257 unique Site/Latitude/Longitude rows
geometry.local_thresholds: q10,q25,q50,q75 of all finite nonzero pairwise site distances, calculated without response values

baseline.method_mix: all sorted method categories as proportions, fixed deterministically from the response schema/data after the single access; no feature selection by association with outcome

layer_b.source_weighting: equal across eligible past positive source sites
layer_b.no_positive_sources_rule: all ten Layer-B features are zero
layer_b.inner_validation_sources: inner-train positive units from prior contexts only
layer_b.outer_sources: all calibration (inner-train + inner-validation) positive units from prior contexts only

selector.metric: macro binary log loss across inner-validation sites
selector.rule: promote Layer B iff augmented inner-validation macro log loss is strictly lower than baseline
selector.refit_after_selection: refit both candidate arms on all calibration units, then score baseline, always-augmented and selected arm on untouched outer sites

primary.metric: macro binary log loss across outer-heldout sites
primary.conservative_miss: baseline preselected but always-augmented outer log loss is lower

interpretation.known_truth_translation_supported_only_i: selected arm has strictly lower outer macro log loss than baseline
interpretation.protective_null: selector transferred harm-avoidance but not real predictive improvement
